title: Ergodic Schrodinger operators on the Bethe lattice and a modified Thouless formula
summary: The main result of this paper is a modified Thouless formula relating the density of states for ergodic Schrodinger operators on the Bethe lattice to the Lyapunov exponent. The modified Thouless formula consists of a Thouless-like term, involving the density of states, and a remainder term. The remainder term vanishes when the connectivity $κ$ equals one, yielding the usual Thouless formula for ergodic Schrodinger operators on $\mathbb{Z}$.
